description: Na₅Ca₄(PO₄)₄F crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to eight O and two equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.62 Å) and four longer (2.92 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.70 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.48 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one P atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Ca atoms to form corner-sharing FNa₂Ca₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
